parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: The button is a small plastic component located at the top of the pen, typically used to extend or retract the writing tip.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as a mechanical actuator that engages the internal spring mechanism to control the pen tip's position.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical part of the pen, made of plastic, providing structure and housing for the ink cartridge and internal mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main grip area and structural support for the pen, containing the ink refill and connecting all other parts.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, providing a stable surface for holding and writing.
